steps.title: Create routes/android-command-routes.js
steps.task: The file MUST begin with a JSDoc block comment containing a line exactly '@ssot docs/products/universal-overlay/PRODUCT_HOME.md' (mandatory, checked by a commit gate). Create a new Express route module exporting a function createAndroidCommandRoutes({ pool, requireKey, logger }) that returns an express.Router(). Include an async function ensureAndroidCommandSchema(pool) that runs: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS android_commands (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_handle TEXT NOT NULL, command TEXT NOT NULL, params JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', result JSONB, claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()) -- call this once lazily (memoized promise, same pattern as ensureDriveSchema in routes/extension-drive-routes.js) before any route handler touches the table. Use crypto.randomUUID() (import crypto from 'node:crypto') for generating command ids. Three routes: (1) router.post('/command', requireKey, async...) reads { user, command, params } from req.body; if command is missing/empty respond 400 { ok:false, error:'command is required' }; otherwise INSERT a new row (user_handle defaulting to 'adam' if user is not provided, params defaulting to {}) and respond 200 { ok:true, command_id }. (2) router.get('/pending-for-user', requireKey, async...) reads user from req.query (default 'adam'), and atomically claims the OLDEST unclaimed pending command for that user using a single SQL UPDATE ... SET claimed_at = now() WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM android_commands WHERE user_handle = $1 AND status = 'pending' AND claimed_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1) RETURNING id, command, params -- mirroring the exact claim pattern already used in routes/extension-drive-routes.js's /pending-for-user. If no row is claimed, respond 200 { ok:true, command_id:null }. Otherwise respond 200 { ok:true, command_id: id, command, params }. (3) router.post('/command-result', requireKey, async...) reads { command_id, ok, result } from req.body; if command_id is missing respond 400 { ok:false, error:'command_id is required' }; otherwise UPDATE android_commands SET status = $2, result = $3::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 (status is 'done' if ok is truthy, else 'failed'), then respond 200 { ok:true }. Wrap every handler body in try/catch, responding 500 { ok:false, error: err.message } on unexpected errors. Default export an object { createAndroidCommandRoutes }. No other routes, no other files.
